AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var repaperEditorHost: null
            readonly property bool repaperToolActive: !!~&6504254477&~.~&501100168435426133&~ && (~&6504254477&~.~&501100168435426133&~ === repaperInkTool || ~&6504254477&~.~&501100168435426133&~ === repaperStencilTool || ~&6504254477&~.~&501100168435426133&~ === repaperSelectTool)
            property string repaperLastWritingPenType: "primary"
            readonly property var repaperWritingPen: repaperLastWritingPenType === "secondary" ? ~&6504254477&~.secondaryPen : ~&6504254477&~.primaryPen
            function repaperRememberWritingPen() {
                const selected = ~&6504254477&~.selectedPen
                if (!selected) return
                if (selected.objectName === "primaryPenMenu") repaperLastWritingPenType = "primary"
                else if (selected.objectName === "secondaryPenMenu") repaperLastWritingPenType = "secondary"
            }
            function repaperResumePen() {
                if (repaperEditorHost && repaperEditorHost.nativeOperationPending) return false
                ~&6504254477&~.selectPen(repaperLastWritingPenType)
                const selected = ~&6504254477&~.selectedPen
                if (!selected || (selected.objectName !== "primaryPenMenu" && selected.objectName !== "secondaryPenMenu")) {
                    ~&6504254477&~.selectPen("primary")
                }
                ~&6504254477&~.closeFoldout()
                repaperRememberWritingPen()
                const current = ~&6504254477&~.selectedPen
                return !!current && (current.objectName === "primaryPenMenu" || current.objectName === "secondaryPenMenu")
            }
            function repaperSetWritingColor(rgb, paletteEnum) {
                if (repaperEditorHost && repaperEditorHost.nativeOperationPending) return false
                if (repaperToolActive) {
                    // Same native PenProperties setters as DocumentView's
                    // penColorSelected handler, preserving the custom tool.
                    repaperWritingPen.color = paletteEnum
                    repaperWritingPen.colorCode = rgb
                } else {
                    const selected = ~&6504254477&~.selectedPen
                    if (!selected || (selected.objectName !== "primaryPenMenu" && selected.objectName !== "secondaryPenMenu")) {
                        if (!repaperResumePen()) return false
                    }
                    ~&6504254477&~.penColorSelected(rgb, paletteEnum)
                }
                return repaperWritingPen.color === paletteEnum && (paletteEnum !== 9 || Number(repaperWritingPen.colorCode) === Number(rgb))
            }
            Connections {
                target: ~&6504254477&~
                function onSelectedPenChanged() { ~&6504254477&~.repaperRememberWritingPen() }
                Component.onCompleted: ~&6504254477&~.repaperRememberWritingPen()
            }
        }

                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/fineliner_tip"
                    label: "reInk"

                    foldoutContent: Loader {
